title: manilkara bidentata var. cruegeri
intro: Manilkara bidentata var. cruegeri, commonly known as the Muntingia tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. Bioactive constituents found in Manilkara bidentata var. cruegeri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its bioactive effects.
